# Time Group (`time`)

Opt-in library group `time`. Disabled by default; enable it in the host environment to call `time.*` functions (see [`spec/packages/f06-groups.md`](../../spec/packages/f06-groups.md)).

| Entry | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`time.parse`](#timeparse) | `time.parse(s: string) => float !` | The seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z of an RFC 3339 date-time. |
| [`time.format`](#timeformat) | `time.format(t: float) => string !` | The RFC 3339 text, in UTC, of a time in seconds since the epoch. |
| [`time.duration`](#timeduration) | `time.duration(s: string) => float !` | The seconds that a duration text such as 1h30m describes. |

## `time.parse`

The seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z of an RFC 3339 date-time.

```text
time.parse: (s: string) => float !
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `s: string` |
| Returns | `float` (may fail with a value error, `!`) |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s)` |
| Allocation units | `0` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-argument` (`not-a-time`) | `value` | s is not a date-time of the accepted form, or a field is out of range |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `time.parse("1970-01-01T00:00:00Z")` |  | `0` |
| `time.parse("2024-02-29T12:30:45Z")` |  | `1709209845` |
| `time.parse("2024-02-29T12:30:45.5+01:00")` |  | `1709206245.5` |
| `time.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00.123456789Z")` |  | `946684800.1234568` |
| `time.parse("2024-01-01T00:00:00.1234567891234Z")` |  | `1704067200.1234567` |
| `time.parse(s)` | `s = "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"` | `1704067200` (1 step, 0 units) |
| `time.parse("2023-02-29T00:00:00Z")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "2023-02-29T00:00:00Z" is not a time in the accepted form |
| `time.parse("1900-02-29T00:00:00Z")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "1900-02-29T00:00:00Z" is not a time in the accepted form |
| `time.parse("2024-13-01T00:00:00Z")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "2024-13-01T00:00:00Z" is not a time in the accepted form |
| `time.parse("2024-00-10T00:00:00Z")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "2024-00-10T00:00:00Z" is not a time in the accepted form |

## `time.format`

The RFC 3339 text, in UTC, of a time in seconds since the epoch.

```text
time.format: (t: float) => string !
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `t: float` |
| Returns | `string` (may fail with a value error, `!`) |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(result)` |
| Allocation units | `1 + sz(result)` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-argument` (`year-range`) | `value` | the year of t, in UTC, is outside 0000 to 9999 |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = 0` | `"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"` (1 step, 1 unit) |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = 1709209845` | `"2024-02-29T12:30:45Z"` |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = 0.5` | `"1970-01-01T00:00:00.5Z"` |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = -0.25` | `"1969-12-31T23:59:59.75Z"` |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = -0.1` | `"1969-12-31T23:59:59.9Z"` |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = 1e-7` | `"1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000001Z"` |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = 253402300800` | Fails: `invalid-argument` — the year of time 253402300800 is outside 0000 to 9999 |
| `time.format(t)` | `t = -62167219200.5` | Fails: `invalid-argument` — the year of time -62167219200.5 is outside 0000 to 9999 |

## `time.duration`

The seconds that a duration text such as 1h30m describes.

```text
time.duration: (s: string) => float !
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `s: string` |
| Returns | `float` (may fail with a value error, `!`) |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s)` |
| Allocation units | `0` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-argument` (`not-a-duration`) | `value` | s is not a duration text |
| `number-range` (`entry`) | `range` | the duration is too large for a number |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `time.duration("90s")` |  | `90` |
| `time.duration("1h30m")` |  | `5400` |
| `time.duration("30m1h")` |  | `5400` |
| `time.duration("1.5h")` |  | `5400` |
| `time.duration("250ms")` |  | `0.25` |
| `time.duration(s)` | `s = "1h"` | `3600` (1 step, 0 units) |
| `time.duration("")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "" is not a duration |
| `time.duration("-")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "-" is not a duration |
| `time.duration("1")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "1" is not a duration |
| `time.duration("0")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — "0" is not a duration |
